policy.strategy: Bounded, per-machine local execution search. No global preset inferred from this test Mac.
policy.generation: Apply reviewed everyday publisher recommendations for Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Gemma4 E2B/E4B/31B, SmolLM3 and R1 Qwen distillations; leave other models on explicitly labeled Hearth defaults. Top-k disabled when publisher only recommends temperature and top-p.
policy.speculation: Test ngram-simple only on reviewed dense/GQA architectures. Every draft is verified by the target. No synthetic acceptance or extra draft weights.
policy.acceptance: At least 8% less total time; no workload or first-answer regression above 15% plus scheduling tolerance; exact greedy outputs and token counts; memory bound; repeat stability within 15%; all prior passing basic checks retained and at least 4/6 passing.
policy.invalidation: Exact weights, profile, engine, machine/OS/power fingerprint, age <30 days.
policy.notImplemented: Target-specific EAGLE3/DFlash/DSpark/MTP draft downloads, TurboQuant custom kernels, arbitrary RoPE stretching and retraining. These need separate backend, target, license, memory and quality validation.
